The '''Stend system''', a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]], contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Stend IV]] and [[Stend VI]]. The former was a [[Temperature/Legends|tropical]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] world with several [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] on its surface and a population of a low [[technology level]]. The latter was a temperate planet of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], plains, and [[City/Legends|urban]] areas and served as a manufacturing and processing site for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Shortly after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], a group of individuals hired by the the anti-technological [[Terrorist/Legends|eco-terrorist]] group [[Army of Life]] traveled to the Stend [[Star system/Legends|system]] aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Majestic Gundark]]''. After an intense [[Showdown on Stend IV|skirmish]] on Stend IV against several parties aiming to stop the group, it eventually succeeded in its mission&mdash;the release of a batch of [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] of the highly invasive [[clodhopper]] creatures into the planet's environment. During the Empire's [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]], several [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]] arose on Stend VI, leading to daily skirmishes in the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]], although the first real local gang, [[the Skulls]], eventually relocated to the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]].

==Description==
The Stend [[Star system/Legends|system]] was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]], which connected it to the [[Ninzam system/Legends|Ninzam]] and [[Lybeya system/Legends|Vergesso systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position in the system was occupied by the [[Temperature/Legends|tropical]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stend IV]].<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" /> It had at least one<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" /> [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-covered continent on its surface as well as several [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. [[Color/Legends|White]] [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] in its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] obscured much of the planet's surface when it was viewed from [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" />

The terrestrial planet [[Stend VI]] occupied the sixth orbit of the system. It had an [[Local year|orbital period]] of 230 [[Local day/Legends|local days]], each of which was twenty-three [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] long, and had three [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. The planet had a temperate climate, and its surface featured [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], plains, and [[City/Legends|urban]] areas.<ref name="Wretched" />

==History==
[[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Stend IV was settled by [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] from the fellow colony world of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> Shortly after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|ended]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Operation Clodhopper timeframe">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20010222part1|text=Operation: Clodhopper Part I: Rendezvous at Frundle's|int=Operation: Clodhopper}} is set "just after the events of Episode I," which refers to [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''The Phantom Menace'', which includes the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the anti-technological [[Terrorist/Legends|eco-terrorist]] group [[Army of Life]] conspired with<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" /> the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] terrorist group [[Knights of the Core]] that wanted to target a continent on Stend IV inhabited by Gran and [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] colonists.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" />

{{RPG|"[[Operation: Clodhopper]]"}}
[[File:Clodhopper.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Army of Life successfully carried out its plan to release eggs of the highly dangerous clodhoppers (pictured) into the environment of Stend IV.]]
The Army of Life hired a group of individuals to transport four hundred [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] of [[clodhopper]]s&mdash;[[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] [[Species/Legends|pests]] infamous for destroying whole planetary ecosystems due to a voracious appetite and rapid rate of [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]]&mdash;aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Majestic Gundark]]'' from Naboo to the largest settlement on Stend IV and release them into the environment. The freighter successfully traveled to Stend IV,<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" /> albeit pursued by a government-tasked group of individuals on a mission to stop the terrorist plot.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" />

When the ''Majestic Gundark'' arrived in the Stend system, its crew did not detect any other [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in the entire system. On Stend IV's surface, the group faced both<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" /> the government-recruited team<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" /> and a group of local Gran settlers led by [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] [[Dree-Tekes]] in an intense [[Showdown on Stend IV|skirmish]] but was ultimately successful in releasing the clodhopper eggs into the environment.<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" />
{{Endgame}}

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], several [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]] arose on Stend VI, leading to daily skirmishes in the planet's skies. The group considered to be the first real gang was [[the Skulls]].<ref name="Wretched" /> By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Skulls date">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', which is set in the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], states that [[the Skulls]] were formed "nearly six [[Standard year/Legends|years]]" ago. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates those two battles to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], respectively, thus placing the formation of the Skulls in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] at the latest.</ref> the Skulls had relocated to the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]], though a new gang known as the [[Razers]] emerged on Stend VI and resumed the Skulls' campaign of terror. At some point, the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Cohden K'Reye]]<ref name="Wretched" /> and the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Nuendo Rash]]<ref name="Hideouts & Strongholds">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref> each visited the Stend VI [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known as [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]].<ref name="Wretched" />

==Inhabitants==
By the time the Invasion of Naboo was repelled,<ref name="Operation Clodhopper timeframe" /> Gran settlers had colonized Stend IV. The colony world was at a low [[Technology level|level]] of technology.<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" /> One continent on Stend IV's surface was also home to Elomin colonists.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" />

Stend VI had a population of 2.2 billion, most of which were [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. The inhabitants of the Outer Rim world were [[Politics/Legends|governed]] by a representative [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]] allied with the Galactic Empire, in which the planet served the role of a manufacturing and processing site. The society on Stend VI had access to space-level technology and maintained an [[Imperial-class spaceport|Imperial-class starport]]. The planet exported consumer goods to other worlds while at the same time importing [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] from elsewhere.<ref name="Wretched" />

==Locations==
[[File:ArgumentInThePits.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Pits on Stend VI]]
There were only a few isolated settlements on Stend IV, of which the only one large enough to be considered a town was [[Gev-Toosa]]. It did not have a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], instead relying on an automated signal that instructed new arrivals to land outside the town and walk to the settlement.<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" />

A prominent location on Stend VI was the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Racer/Legends|racer]] bar known as The Pits. It was owned by the legendary swoop racer [[Blizz Pinnix]], while the establishment's day-to-day operations of The Pits were overseen by the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] businessman [[Kaylo NaKuda]]. NaKuda also owned the adjacent vehicle repair garage and dealership [[Kuda's Compound]], which&mdash;unbeknownst to Pinnix&mdash;sold mostly stolen vehicles and parts and was staffed by [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. The latter included [[Sil Vaturha]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] orphan who possibly had some of the greatest technological skills of the inhabitants of the<ref name="Wretched" /> Juris<ref name="EAOC" /> and neighboring [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].<ref name="Wretched" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Stend system was first depicted in illustrations of Stend VI's night skies included in ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a [[1997]] sourcebook written by [[Paul Danner]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Wretched" /> The first proper appearance of the system and the introduction of its name came in "[[Operation: Clodhopper]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] mini-adventure authored by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[February 22]], [[2001]] for use with the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Operation Clodhopper" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Stend system in grid square P-17.<ref name="TEA" />
